lines.en: Creeps forward with a sobbing wail
Drifts through stone corridors
Spectrally drifts down the hallway
Passes the altar with whispering sounds
Wanders along the walls of the cathedral
Ghostly form drifts in candlelight
Passes between the altars
Gently floats past the altar
Moves slowly on the altar
Spectrally wends through the stone statues
Gliding between the extinguished candlesticks.

lines.zh: 长袍拖着骨灰缓缓前行
lines.en: My robe drags through the bone ash as I drift.
Quiets in mid-air
Stands quietly on the altar
Drifts above the altar
Drifts gently between the stone statues
Quiets above the altar
Whispers past the altar
Hangs between the stone statues
Stands silently on the altar
Whispers past the altar quietly
Quiets between the stone statues
Hovering beneath the shattered stained glass.

lines.zh: 数着教堂里残存的烛火
lines.en: Counting the last candles left in the nave.

lines.zh: 在无人的告解室旁沉默
lines.en: Silent beside the empty confessional.
Circling quietly under the vaulted ceiling.

lines.zh: 教堂的长椅下面，我一直都在。
lines.en: I've always been under the cathedral pews.
The cathedral pews have been empty so long.
Glaring menacingly at the player
I count the steps you climb.

lines.zh: 教堂的长椅自己挪了一下。
lines.en: A pew in the chapel shifts by itself.
Stares through the player

lines.zh: 教堂的长椅，还留着我的位置。
lines.en: My seat on the cathedral bench is still empty.

lines.zh: 我在彩窗后，看你点蜡烛。
lines.en: Behind the stained glass, I watch you light a candle.

lines.zh: 用空洞的眼神注视玩家
lines.en: Staring at the player with hollow eyes
My face floats in the holy water.
I watch you from behind the broken icon.

lines.zh: 冰冷的视线落到你身上
lines.en: My cold gaze settles on you.

lines.zh: 我在你身后的烛影里看你
lines.en: I watch from the candle shadow behind you.
The bell has stopped, yet I still watch you.
I look at you with eyes I no longer have.

lines.zh: 视线从祭坛那头缠上你
lines.en: My gaze coils toward you from the far altar.
I count your heartbeats as I watch.
Every step you back away, I am watching.
The hollow beneath my robe turns toward you.

lines.zh: 我在你的影子里打量你
lines.en: I study you from inside your own shadow.

lines.zh: 幽灵飘忽，身体消散在风中。
lines.en: Faint, your ghost dissipates in the breeze.
My strength wanes, I can barely float.

lines.zh: 灵魂虚弱，我快支撑不住了。
lines.en: My spirit is weak, I cannot hold on.

lines.zh: 飘忽不定，我几乎要消失。
lines.en: Invisible, I am nearly gone.
My spectral form wavers.

lines.zh: 飘忽而过，但我无力再行走。
lines.en: I drift, but I cannot walk.
My spectral form fades, wavering and weak.
My spirit floats, weak and uncertain.
My drifting spirit trembles.
A weak soul, wavering and unsure.

lines.zh: 你身上的光芒让我难以接近。
lines.en: The light on you makes it hard for me to get close.

lines.zh: 你的影子在夜晚拉得更长。
lines.en: Your shadow stretches longer in the night.

lines.zh: 你身上的气息吸引着我。
lines.en: Your presence draws me in.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸唤起了我的欲望。
lines.en: Your breath stirs my desire.

lines.zh: 你身上的温暖让我心动。
lines.en: The warmth on you stirs my heart.

lines.zh: 你身上的魔法让我着迷。
lines.en: The magic on you fascinates me.

lines.zh: 你身上的光芒让我分心。
lines.en: The light on you distracts me.

lines.zh: 你身上的气息让我无法抗拒。
lines.en: Your presence makes me unable to resist.

lines.zh: 你身上的气息让我心乱。
lines.en: Your presence confuses me.

lines.zh: 你身上的气息让我着迷。
lines.en: Your presence fascinates me.

lines.zh: 我必须触碰你才能消失。
lines.en: I must touch you to disappear.
You touch my soul.
You bumped into my ghost.
You pass through me, and your bones go cold.
You inadvertently touched me.
You accidentally touched me.

lines.zh: 我的虚影附着在你身上。
lines.en: My ghost clings to you.
You touched my phantom.

lines.zh: 你无意中触动了我的存在。
lines.en: You inadvertently touched my existence.
You touched my nothingness.

lines.zh: 与我并肩，成为我的伴侣。
lines.en: Stand beside me, be my mate.
Let us spend the eternal night together.

lines.zh: 圣水洒了一地，也没赶走我。
lines.en: Holy water everywhere, and I'm still here.

lines.zh: 让我们结为永恒的伴侣。
lines.en: Let us be eternal mates.
Be my eternal companion.

lines.zh: 与我共度时光，直到永远。
lines.en: Stay with me, until the end of time.

lines.zh: 空无一人的婚礼上，我等你。
lines.en: At an empty wedding, I wait for you.
Be my eternal companion.
Let us share this life.

lines.zh: 在废墟尽头与我相守吧
lines.en: Stay with me at the ruin's end.

lines.zh: 飘忽的灵体，夜幕降临即现形！
lines.en: The Cathedral Ghost appears at night.

lines.zh: 苍白的面庞，如同被诅咒！
lines.en: Pale face, cursed for all eternity.

lines.zh: 夜风中回荡着幽怨的呢喃！
lines.en: Whispers of the damned on the wind.

lines.zh: 灵魂的叹息，冰冷而凄厉！
lines.en: Chilling sighs of a lost soul.

lines.zh: 腐朽的长袍，飘荡在风中！
lines.en: Decaying robe, billowing in the wind.

lines.zh: 你触碰不到的存在，却能感知！
lines.en: An entity you can’t touch, but feel.

lines.zh: 夜晚的游荡者，寻找着无辜的灵魂！
lines.en: Wandering the night, seeking innocent souls.

lines.zh: 古老教堂的守护者，永世的徘徊！
lines.en: Guardian of the ancient church, forever wandering.

lines.zh: 黑暗中飘来的，无形的威胁！
lines.en: Invisible threat, carried on the night.

lines.zh: 灵魂的囚徒，无尽的苦痛！
lines.en: A prisoner of the soul, endless torment.
The scent of prey, so alluring.
Target acquired, now there's no escape.

lines.zh: 寂静中传来心跳的声音！
lines.en: Heartbeat in the silence.
Soul whispers, guiding me.

lines.zh: 目标就在眼前，伸手可及！
lines.en: Target in sight, within reach.
The scent of prey, so familiar.
Silhouette of prey in the dark.
Soul resonance, near and dear.
Prey scent intensifies.

lines.zh: 猎物就在手边，一网打尽！
lines.en: Prey in hand, all yours.
Your breath stirs the dust.
I have found the warmth of the living.
The bell still rings, and you are in my sight.

lines.zh: 尸骨堆里多了一个活物
lines.en: One living thing among the heaps of bone.
I hear the echo of your footsteps.

lines.zh: 灯光照到了不该来的你
lines.en: The light reveals you, where you should not be.
Spirit chains bind the soul.
Spirit chains tightened.
Soul’s chains, unbreakable.

lines.zh: 灵魂的锁链，锁定了命运！
lines.en: Spirit chains bind destiny.
Soul shackles, snugly fitted.

lines.zh: 灵魂的锁链，永恒的束缚！
lines.en: Eternal spirit chains.
Soul shackles, for eternity.

lines.zh: 灵魂的锁链，一寸寸收紧！
lines.en: Spirit chains, inching tighter.
Soul shackles tighten.
Eternal spirit chains bind.

lines.zh: 寒冷从脚底爬上你的身
lines.en: The cold climbs up from your feet.
You will not leave this cathedral.
I close in on you inch by inch.
The air turns cold around me.
The door behind you has already shut.
The candles are out; only I remain.
I have taken hold of your shadow first.
Silently, I come close to the back of your neck.
I am waiting for your next step.
The whole cathedral helps me corner you.
Scream and lunge at you!

lines.zh: 缓缓靠近，伸出苍白双手！
lines.en: Creep closer, stretch out pale hands!

lines.zh: 挥舞腐烂之翼，试图吞噬！
lines.en: Swing decayed wings, attempt to devour!

lines.zh: 用嘶哑声音呢喃，招来恐惧！
lines.en: Whisper with a hoarse voice, instill fear!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，试图吸干你的生命！
lines.en: Sssss, try to drain your life!

lines.zh: 发出尖锐嚎叫，使你颤抖！
lines.en: Scream shrilly, make you tremble!

lines.zh: 挥动手臂，试图抓住你的灵魂！
lines.en: Swing arms, try to grab your soul!

lines.zh: 你感到一股冰冷气息，随之而来！
lines.en: You feel a cold aura, it’s coming!

lines.zh: 幽灵的眼睛闪烁，寻找下一个猎物！
lines.en: Its ghostly eyes flicker, searching for a next prey!

lines.zh: 用冰冷的手触碰你，试图吸取生命力！
lines.en: Touch you with icy hands, try to drain life force!

lines.zh: 冰冷的手指穿过你的肩
lines.en: Cold fingers pass through your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我贴上来，吸走你的热气
lines.en: I press close and drink your warmth.
My robe coils around your arm.
Ash blows into your face.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的影子往下拉
lines.en: I drag your shadow downward.
A wail fills your ears.

lines.zh: 从教堂的破败墙壁中冒出！
lines.en: Spawn from the crumbling walls of the church!
Appear in the dark passage!
Emerge from the cracks in the altar!

lines.zh: 在昏暗的圣器室中现身！
lines.en: Spawn in the dimly lit sanctuary!
Appear in the shadows of the altar!

lines.zh: 从教堂的钟楼顶上降落！
lines.en: Descend from the church’s bell tower!

lines.zh: 在昏暗的祭司宿舍中现身！
lines.en: Spawn in the dimly lit priest’s quarters!
Emerge from the shadows of the graveyard!

lines.zh: 在教堂的地下室中现身！
lines.en: Spawn in the church’s basement!

lines.zh: 在教堂的钟声响起时现身！
lines.en: Spawn when the church’s bell rings!
The candle gutters, and I am here.
I slip in through the cracked window.

lines.zh: 骨灰堆里立起一个影子
lines.en: A shadow rises from the bone ash.

lines.zh: 在空无一人的长椅上成形
lines.en: I take shape on the empty pews.
The prayer breaks, and I appear.
I drift out from beneath the fallen idol.

lines.zh: 教堂的地砖裂了，我来了
lines.en: The floor tiles split, and I come forth.
I come down along the sound of the bell.
Candle smoke gathers into my shape.

lines.zh: 在失落文明的礼拜堂醒来
lines.en: I wake in the chapel of a lost civilization.
The flames scorch, I cannot endure.

lines.zh: 从高处坠落，我的灵魂破碎。
lines.en: Falling from heights, my soul shatters.
Drowned, I suffocate.
The explosion rips through me.

lines.zh: 箭矢穿透，我的灵魂受到伤害。
lines.en: The arrow pierces, wounding my soul.
The magic strikes, weakening me.

lines.zh: 饥饿摧残，我的灵魂空虚。
lines.en: Starvation weakens, my soul is empty.

lines.zh: 闪电击中，我的灵魂被撕裂。
lines.en: Lightning strikes, my soul is torn apart.
Falling into the void, my soul dissipates.
